title: An answered ask on the waiting page can be dismissed
why: Your ask, 11:22 CST Nov 6: there is no way to dismiss a completed ask. Answered asks stay on the page for good, so old ones bury new ones.
note:
Nov 6 12:01 CST (coordinator replan: Opus plan and critic, main 7975f6d8, roadmap 01995020): lane live.
Nov 6 11:33 CST (triage): done means each answered ask has a Dismiss press next to its reply box (step ask-reply-back); a press writes `dismissed` on asks/<id>, the page hides dismissed asks, and the writer never rewrites a dismissed ask. The coordinator starts the lane; it touches a screen, so it gets a designer and a design reviewer.
